evidence.field: 館 graph structure, lexical senses, readings, and cited older forms
evidence.text: The entry analyzes 館 as 食 semantic + 官 phonetic and glosses its core sense as guest lodging. It cites 詩經《鄭風·緇衣》「適子之館兮」 and examples where 館 means an elaborate residence, an official institution, a teaching venue, or a lodging verb. It lists the Guangyun fanqie 古玩 and Middle Chinese category 見母、合口一等、去聲; these are dictionary traditions, not a dated semantic sequence.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭 「館」

evidence.text: The database says oracle-bone 宛 consists of 宀 and 夗 and was read as 館 for lodging; it also cites a bronze inscription transcribed 仲義父作新宛(館)寶鼎 and interprets 新宛 as a newly built lodging. The displayed entry does not give a secure date or artifact image for that inscription, so it supports the database's reported reading, not an independently verified date or form.
evidence.title: 漢字甲骨部件分析: 宀

evidence.text: This secondary account proposes that 宛 was first used for the lodging word, that 食 was added to form 𩜌, and that 官 later replaced 宛 as phonetic after a sound merger. It cites 金文形義通解 and 古文字譜系疏証 for the earlier forms and Baxter's 1992 Old Chinese phonology for the sound-change proposal. The inspected primary sources do not independently establish this full sequence; it remains a cited proposal.
evidence.title: 館 - ウィクショナリー日本語版

evidence.source: Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants, Taiwan
evidence.field: Shuowen analysis, fanqie, cited textual tradition, and semantic entries
evidence.text: The 館 entry quotes Shuowen: 客舍也。从食，官聲, followed by a Zhouli passage about route markets, lodging stations and provisions for visiting guests, with 古玩切. It lists lodging, residences, reception/lodging as a verb, teaching venues, eating or service establishments, government offices, and cultural public venues. These citations provide lexical attestations in later textual traditions but the page does not date each usage or demonstrate a chronology among them.
evidence.title: [A04602] 館 - Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.field: modern and historical pronunciation of 館
evidence.text: The entry displays Mandarin guǎn, a Cantonese sound entry, Guangyun 古玩, and Middle Chinese initials/final/grade/tone categories. The separate Japanese Wiktionary entry reports Mandarin guǎn, Cantonese gun2, Middle Chinese kwanH, Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese *[k]ˤo[n]ʔ-s, and Zhengzhang *koːnʔ/*koːns. The latter reconstructions are system-specific; their comparison with 官 depends on the secondary account's cited sound-change analysis, not on modern Mandarin alone.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭 「館」

evidence.field: 官 modern Mandarin and Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese pronunciation
evidence.text: The entry gives Mandarin guān and Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese /*kʷˤa[n]/ for 官. Compared with 館's Baxter-Sagart form as reported in the 館 entry, this supports a broad historical phonetic relationship within that reconstruction system, although the secondary sound-change account for the specific earlier 宛-to-官 replacement was not verified from Baxter's book.
evidence.title: 官 - Wiktionary, the free dictionary

evidence.field: Shuowen seal glyph image identity and reuse license
evidence.text: The file page describes this as a digitally rendered 館 in Shuowen seal script style, lists Sinica and other character databases among available sources, and states the representation is public domain. It is a modern vector redraw, not a photograph or scan of an ancient artifact.
evidence.title: File:館-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.source: Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants, Taiwan
evidence.text: The CUHK 館 entry links 馆 as the simplified counterpart. The inspected references did not establish a dated standardization for the 食-to-饣 simplification or prove the exact graphic was absent from earlier informal writing.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭 「館」

search_audit.outcome: Inspected CUHK 館 entry and search result for 宛/官 material. The MOE 官 URL timed out on open. The inspected sources distinguish 館's 食+官 analysis from a separate earlier 宛 lodging-use account.

search_audit.query: Open Wikimedia Commons 館 oracle and bronze candidate files and 館 big-seal file
search_audit.outcome: Oracle, bronze, and big-seal file opens failed (internal errors/cache miss). Their identity and reuse provenance were not established, so they were not selected. The Commons 館-seal page was inspected successfully.

gaps: The earliest securely dated inscription for the lodging word remains unestablished. CUHK reports oracle-bone and bronze uses of 宛 for 館 but the inscription date, artifact image, and reading were not independently checked against a primary publication.

The link between lodging and later meanings such as institutions, restaurants, schools, and museums is not demonstrated as a dated semantic chain. Dictionary examples are evidence for uses, not proof of their relative chronology.

Shuowen's 食+官 analysis supports the traditional compound analysis, but does not settle how it relates to the earlier 宛 spelling reported by CUHK. A separate proposal says 𩜌 preceded 館 and 官 replaced 宛 after a sound merger; the detailed reconstruction has not been checked directly against Baxter or the cited paleographic monographs.

官 has modern Mandarin guān and 館 has guǎn; modern readings alone do not establish the historical phonetic relation. The cited Old Chinese comparisons are framework-specific secondary data; the proposed exact merger and replacement pathway remains insufficiently verified.

The target is simplified 馆, while the best-established component analysis is for traditional 館. Available sources identify 馆 as its simplified counterpart but do not date the standardization of 饣 in this character.
No sound borrowing of a whole graph is proposed. No depicted object or recoverable object-name borrowing claim was found.

The Commons candidate is a modern redraw in a historical seal-script style, not an artifact photograph. The Xiaoxuetang target page and additional Commons form variants could not be inspected; only the selected Commons seal redraw has verified identity and reuse provenance.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script tradition; historical model associated with the Han dictionary tradition, exact graphic date unspecified
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 館 in a Shuowen seal-script style. It illustrates the traditional 食+官 form cited by Shuowen; it is not an ancient artifact image.
items.alt: Black seal-script style 館 glyph redrawn as a vector on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: The Commons description explicitly identifies the glyph as 館 in Shuowen seal style and reports public-domain status; it provides a useful visual counterpart to the traditional dictionary component analysis.
items.rights: Public domain according to the Commons file description; redraw, not a scan or artifact photo.

limitations.text: One usable glyph image was verified. Xiaoxuetang access failed and Commons oracle/bronze/big-seal candidate pages returned errors, so this selection cannot illustrate the disputed earlier 宛/𩜌 graphic sequence.
